stages.title: Workspace state and platform adapters
stages.objective: Move workspace state, API access, and shared workspace types out of the flat UI directory into clear workspace and platform-adapter boundaries. Update imports without changing behavior.
completion_criteria: Workspace state, API, and types have a feature-based organization consistent with their responsibilities.
Tauri command access remains behind the platform adapter boundary.

The existing command names and argument mappings are preserved. Confirmed Tauri `invoke` appears only in the platform adapter, and `pnpm --filter @marnote/desktop typecheck` passes.

Updated the workspace imports and removed the obsolete flat UI modules: `useWorkspace.ts`, `workspaceApi.ts`, and `workspaceTypes.ts`. The UI now points to the workspace feature and platform adapter paths.

Validation passed: `pnpm --filter @marnote/desktop typecheck`. A search found no remaining imports of the old flat workspace paths.
